sentences.text: Pauropetalichthys is classified as a placoderm, an ancient group of armored fish.
The only known species in this genus is Pauropetalichthys magnoculus, which serves as the type species.
The genus Pauropetalichthys was described by Pan and colleagues in 2015.
Only one fossil occurrence of Pauropetalichthys has been recorded.
Pauropetalichthys belongs to the family Quasipetalichthyidae.
This animal lived during the Emsian stage of the Early Devonian epoch, between 419.62 and 413.02 million years ago.
Fossils of Pauropetalichthys magnoculus have been found in Yunnan, China.
